scenario: A `call` with `on`, `timeout` and `error` clauses compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. LCCO.4.1 names the synthetic rules this generates: `<rule>#call0`, `$<rule>_response_0`, `$<rule>_timeout_0` and `$<rule>_error_0`. `compile_ok` reads none of those names.
rules_ds:
schema SvcMethodReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service svc.method:
    """stub"""
    response SvcMethodReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule my_rule:
    Trig
->
    call svc.method cooldown: 30_s
        on response.code == 200:
            log info "ok"
        timeout 5_s:
            log info "timeout"
        error:
            log info "error"
